callGraph.callee:
[
        "---",
        `name: ${name}`,
        `description: Synthetic perf skill ${pad(i, 3)} for the ${scope} budget corpus`,
        "---",
        "",
        `# ${name}`,
        "",
        "Body line for the detail-read path. " + "filler ".repeat(12),
        "",
        "- list item one",
        "- list item two",
        "",
      ].join

list
          .flatMap((r) => [
            { t: r.start, delta: 1 },
            { t: r.end, delta: -1 },
          ])
          .sort

(browser as unknown as { process?: () => { kill: (signal?: string) => void; killed: boolean } | null })
      .process
